Columns

The names of the columns to read, in the order the reader gives them; every column that holds a single value per row when not set. Only those columns are read from the file.

RowGroupFilter

A condition that row groups are checked against by the statistics of their columns, and the pages of their columns by the page index when the file has one, to skip those that cannot hold a row that satisfies it. It only prunes: the rows of the row groups and pages that are read are all given, whether they satisfy the condition or not. All the rows are read when it is not set.

public ParquetFilter? RowGroupFilter { get; init; }
